problem: a venue closed on one trip day was unschedulable on every day
mechanism_already_existed: applies_to_dates was written on the opening_interval fact and consumed by nothing; the per-date windows were in opening_intervals()['by_date'] and never reached the optimizer

changes.opening.common_interval: overlap across open days instead of refusing; returns open_dates; interval and CLOSED_ON_A_TRIP_DATE reason now coexist
changes.actions._optimizer_input: applies_to_dates = the open dates, not every trip date
changes.optimizer._open_on: consulted by _earliest_visit_start (returns None for a shut day) and validate_variant (CLOSED_DURING_VISIT)
changes.fixtures_unaffected: a fact without applies_to_dates applies everywhere

tests.honesty: the end-to-end walk does not discriminate — the fixture's only open day is the one the optimizer picks anyway, so _earliest_visit_start is asserted directly and that assertion does fail when the guard is removed

cost.note: no provider call; the data was already bought on 2026-08-06 for US$0.225
